capabilities: Create reveal.js presentations from Markdown notes
Style slides with themes and annotations
Export slides as PDF or HTML
extras: Manifest describes it as a fork of Advanced Slides; README covers manual installation and BRAT setup in detail but gives no examples of slide syntax.
motivation: The original author discontinued the plugin, and the new maintainer 'picks up where Matthäus left off'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into presentation decks, so users must leave the vault or use other tools to build slides.

relations.evidence: I'm just picking up where Matthäus left off.

summary: Slide deck creator that builds reveal.js presentations from Markdown notes with themes, embedded notes, and PDF/HTML export.
